en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Imam Abu Abdullah (as) was asked about a man who married a Dhimmi woman (non-Muslim under Muslim protection) while already married to a Muslim woman.
Imam (as) said: "They should be separated, and he should be given one-eighth of the prescribed punishment, which amounts to twelve and a half lashes. However, if the Muslim woman consents to it, he should still receive one-eighth of the punishment, but they should not be separated."
I asked: "How is half a lash administered?"
Imam (as) replied: "The whip is held by its middle, and he is struck with it."
